written.myAnswer: Copyright protects original works; trademarks distinguish goods or services by their names, symbols, or slogans; patents protect new inventions or processes.
Respecting intellectual property rights is important because using protected work without permission is unethical and may be illegal, while respecting these rights supports creators.
Software piracy is the unauthorized copying, distribution, or use of software. It harms developers by depriving them of income needed to create and improve their products.

Copyright protects creators’ original works; trademarks distinguish products or services through names, symbols, or slogans; patents protect new inventions or processes by granting inventors exclusive rights for a limited period.

Use protected content only with permission or by purchasing it legally, and use software according to its licence. Unauthorized copying, sharing, or use is unethical and can be illegal. Software piracy deprives developers of income needed to create and improve their products.
